draft.description: A user-supplied placement draft. ledger.py assigns placement_id, entry_timestamp, prev_hash and entry_hash when it seals the entry; status may only be pending or claimed at add time — verified is granted only by verify_entry() with proof.

production.description: The production the track was placed in — film, series episode, game title, ad campaign, trailer, podcast episode.

proof_url.description: Public evidence of the placement (production credits page, press, cue sheet). Required before an entry may be promoted to verified.

scene.description: The scene or usage — where in the production the needle drops, and how the track is used.

status.description: Draft entries may only be pending or claimed. verify_entry() promotes to verified with proof.

timestamp.description: When the needle dropped — the in-production placement moment (date or datetime).

track.description: Catalog track title, exactly as it appears in the catalog.

entry.description: A sealed ledger entry. entry_hash = sha256 over the canonical JSON of the entry EXCLUDING entry_hash itself, with prev_hash included. The chain links each entry to the previous one; verify() recomputes every hash.

entry_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical entry payload (this field excluded).

entry_timestamp.description: When this entry was written to the ledger (UTC).

prev_hash.description: entry_hash of the previous entry, or GENESIS for the first.

revision.description: Append-only audit note written by verify_entry() on every promotion. verify() checks that every verified entry has a matching revision note with consistent hashes.

terms.description: Placement terms. Private terms are recorded as "undisclosed" — real numbers are never invented, and "undisclosed" is never upgraded to a guess.

fee_tier.description: Fee band or "undisclosed". Never a fabricated number.

description: NEEDLE DROP — the agent's placement résumé. Every sync placement an agent lands (scene, timestamp, terms) is logged as a hash-chained ledger entry: proof of work it carries with it. Entries are added only on verification; the ledger ships empty and stays honest. Static, cacheable, no login.

head.description: entry_hash of the latest entry, or GENESIS when the ledger is empty.

revisions.description: Append-only audit notes for verify_entry() promotions.

placements.description: Sealed placement entries, oldest first. Ships empty: entries are added only on verification.

title: NEEDLE DROP placement ledger
